d:
光輝模型為我們帶來了將近兩年的歡樂，
而如今 Anima 模型的到來，結合阿里巴巴的通義千問，讓開源 AI 圖像領域更上一層樓。

目前 Anima 僅釋出 Ver 0.3 的預覽版本，但已經展現出驚人的潛力。由於仍處於早期階段，人物質感尚未完全成熟，因此我使用 Anima Ver 0.3 搭配個人的「ppkkmoon_魔域之墮姫_model_V2」模型進行後處理，完成了這組作品，以展示 Anima 的發展潛力。

最後，感謝 circlestone_labs 為我們帶來如此優秀的開源模型，也期待在未來數月內能順利迎來 Anima 的正式版本。

The Illustrious model has brought us nearly two years of joy.
Now, with the arrival of the Anima model, combined with Alibaba’s Qwen, the open-source AI image generation field is reaching a whole new level.

Currently, Anima has only released a preview version, Ver 0.3, yet it already demonstrates remarkable potential. As the model is still in its early stages, the character rendering quality is not fully refined. Therefore, I used Anima Ver 0.3 together with my own "ppkkmoon_Daemon_Realm_V2" for post-processing to create this set of images, showcasing Anima’s potential.

Finally, thanks to circlestone_labs for bringing us such an excellent open-source model. I look forward to the official release of Anima in the coming months.
